title: 70s Editorial Studies
description: Nine independent pages from a neo-retro 70s magazine — each study isolates one facet of the decade's editorial visual grammar (halftone dots, sunburst rays, slab-serif titles, tombstone photography) at modern print precision.
creative_direction: Every study is a different page type from a fictional 70s-style magazine rebuilt at modern resolution. Warm orange-brown-mustard palette stays consistent; halftone dot density and slab-serif weight vary by page role. Images are independent — no cross-page character continuity.
